knownDeltas: The href host is the in-process test server (http://localhost); Esri's sample href points at their sample service. The export envelope (width/height/extent) is the parity contract.
Rendered pixels are engine-native VIPS output and covered structurally by imageserver-export-image, never byte-compared here.
The href echoes the request query with f=image; commas stay unencoded (ASP.NET QueryString.Create), unlike Esri's percent-encoded sample href.
name: imageserver-export
notes: Export envelope (ImageServer/exportImage?f=json): the doc-pattern bbox/size/format over the published raster; the replay pins the image href plus dimensions and extent.
source: Esri REST docs: Export Image (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-image.htm); bbox/size/format pattern
